#Part B1
```{r}
students<-data.frame(
  id = 1:8,
  
  name = c("Alice","Bruno","Chen","Dana","Elif","Farid","Grace","Hiro"),
  sex = c("F","M","M","F","F","M","F","M"),
  Section = c("A","B","A","C","B","C","A","B"),
  midterm = c(78,85,92,67,74,88,95,59),
  final = c(82,79,96,71,80,91,93,65),
  attendance = c(95,88,100,72,90,85,98,60),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


#Part B2
str(students)
dim(students)
names(students)
summary(students)


#Part B3
students$average<-round((students$midterm = students$final)/ 2, 1)
students

#Part B4
students$passed<-students$average>=70 & students$attendance>= 75
students

#Part B5
students$standing<-
  ifelse(students$average>=90, "Honors",
         ifelse(students$average>=75, "Good","Needs Suppport"))
students
```
PART C: rbind() and cbind()
```{r}
# PART C: rbind() and cbind()

# C1

new_students <- data.frame(
id = c(9, 10),
name = c("Ines", "Jamal"),
sex = c("F", "M"),
section = c("C", "A"),
midterm = c(81, 70),
final = c(84, 68),
attendance = c(92, 80),
stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

new_students$average <- round((new_students$midterm + new_students$final) / 2, 1)
new_students$passed <- new_students$average >= 70 & new_students$attendance >= 75
new_students$standing <-
ifelse(new_students$average >= 90, "Honors",
ifelse(new_students$average >= 75, "Good", "Needs Support"))

students_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(students, new_students)
students_all
``` 

# C2
```{r}
quiz <- c(8, 7, 10, 6, 7, 9, 10, 5, 8, 6)
students_all <- cbind(students_all, quiz)
class(students_all)
``` 

# C3
```{r}
m <- cbind(midterm = students_all$midterm, final = students_all$final)
m <- rbind(m, mean = colMeans(m))
m
```

# C4
```{r}
bad <- data.frame(wrong_col = 1)
tryCatch(rbind(students, bad), error = function(e) { message("rbind failed: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })

# Answer: When rbind() is called on our data frames, the R displays an error. Because rbind() requires matching column names in the data. Using tryCatch(rbind(students, bad), error = function(e) { message("rbind failed: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL }) allows the R to display a message without stopping the complie and run.
```
